_source: Labelled directly by the data owner (Jesse), 2026-08-24, interactively, one question per session with evidence shown. This is the ONLY trustworthy wing ground truth that exists: every in-system signal (existing wings, lexical mentions, session hints) measures mention rather than aboutness.

labels.note: opens with chit-chat; labelled by the substantive work mid-session
session hint said getladle (5h stale) — hint was WRONG
content says 'Loft' — voice transcription of LAUFT; lexical matching cannot catch this class
weather/ambient assistant use — general is a CORRECT answer, the target is not zero
operating the assistant's UI counts as infrastructure, NOT permagent
permagent-runtime -> getladle -> personal(mortgage) -> enrichment; boundaries fall exactly on 152m/67m/1068m gaps
atlas-atlantic -> tide data -> Greece travel -> harness; subject changes here have NO time gap

_disambiguation._warning: near-homonyms; any lexical or naive-bayes classifier conflates them. They are two of the largest wings (103 and 379 memories).
